entity.valdren.lightless_knight.enrage: The Lightless Knight is enraged! Raiders answer his call.
entity.valdren.storm_dragon.enrage: Vorthrax roars! The storm grows more violent.
item.valdren.ancestral_flame.lore: The fire of the first king's forge never died in it.
item.valdren.broken_seal.lore: Break it to free the Lightless Knight.
item.valdren.broken_seal.summon: The seal breaks. The Lightless Knight rises from the shadows!
item.valdren.crimson_fang.lore: Taken from the Crimson Brotherhood. Drinks the life of those it wounds.
item.valdren.dusk_blade.lore: Made from the last light before the Eclipse.
item.valdren.echo_fragment.lore: A piece of memory from the old Echo Crown.
item.valdren.frost_blade.lore: Forged in the eternal ice of the Northern Waste.
item.valdren.frost_crystal.lore: Never melts, not even in fire.
item.valdren.npc_call.lore: Click a block to place this traveler permanently (they won't leave).
item.valdren.sentinel_greatsword.lore: The royal guard captain's weapon. Heavy as an oath.
item.valdren.shadow_essence.lore: Cold to the touch. Whispers when no one is looking.
item.valdren.storm_edge.lore: Still hums with the thunder of Vorthrax.
item.valdren.storm_horn.lore: Blow it under open sky to call Vorthrax.
item.valdren.storm_horn.summon: The sky darkens... Vorthrax, the Storm Dragon, answers the call!
item.valdren.storm_scale.lore: Torn from Vorthrax. Crackles with electricity.
item.valdren.verdant_blade.lore: A tree of the Ancient Grove grew around the steel.
valdren.dialogue.affinity: Affinity: %s of %s points to the next level (%s)
valdren.effect.sentinel: On hit: knocks back and weakens
valdren.effect.storm: On hit: chance of lightning that jumps to up to 2 enemies
valdren.guide.page.0:
§l§4Chronicles of Valdren§r


A traveler's guide



§8Written by Master Orvyn, chronicler of Valdren.
valdren.guide.page.1:
§lThe shattered realm§r

Long ago the Echo Crown shattered. The pieces, the §3Echo Fragments§r, still hold memories of the old kingdom... and draw dark things.
valdren.guide.page.10:
§lBoss: Vorthrax§r

The Storm Dragon fights on the ground and in the air. Circles of sparks on the ground = lightning incoming!

Blow the §3Storm Horn§r under open sky.
valdren.guide.page.11:
§lBlades of Valdren§r

Eight blades, each with an on-hit effect.

Get them from quests, trades, bosses and crafting. Hover over one to see its effect.
valdren.guide.page.12:
§lRecipes§r

§3Frost Blade§r
Frost Crystal, diamond and stick.

§4Crimson Fang§r
Shadow Essence, block of redstone and stick.
valdren.guide.page.13:
§lRecipes§r

§5Broken Seal§r
4 Echo Fragments, 2 Shadow Essences and 1 iron ingot.

§6This guide§r
Book and feather.
valdren.guide.page.14:
§lEpic Fight§r

With Epic Fight installed, the blades get longsword, tachi, greatsword and katana movesets. Humanoid enemies fight with its animations.
valdren.guide.page.15:
§8May the echo of the crown guide your steps.


— Orvyn§r


§7Tip: a traveler's Call (creative tab) places them permanently wherever you want.
valdren.guide.page.2:
§lThe travelers§r

Four travelers roam from village to village. Each appears at a different time. Look near the village bell.

When their time is over, they move on.
valdren.guide.page.3:
§lSchedules§r

§6Bram§r, blacksmith:
morning and early afternoon.

§2Granny Iara§r, herbalist:
afternoon.

§1Master Orvyn§r, chronicler:
dusk.

§8Ravena§r, huntress:
night.
valdren.guide.page.4:
§lTalking§r

Right-click a traveler. Answer with the mouse, arrow keys, Enter or keys 1 to 9.

Answers in §6yellow§r have news: a quest or a trade.
valdren.guide.page.5:
§lAffinity§r

Talking every day, hearing stories, trading and finishing quests raise affinity.

Levels: Stranger, Acquaintance, Comrade, Friend and Confidant.
valdren.guide.page.6:
§lQuests§r

Each traveler has quests to hunt creatures or bring items. Some only appear with more affinity.

Daily quests come back after a day.
valdren.guide.page.7:
§lCreatures§r

§5Shadow Wolf§r
Forests and taigas, at night. Hunts in packs and its bite blinds.

§9Frost Wraith§r
Snowy lands. Throws ice, but fears fire.
valdren.guide.page.8:
§4Crimson Raider§r
Plains and savannas, at night. Bandits of the Crimson Brotherhood hunting Echo Fragments.

They usually carry swords and axes.
valdren.guide.page.9:
§lBoss:
Lightless Knight§r

The former captain of the royal guard. Dashes like a shadow and strikes the ground with the Eclipse.

Break the §5Broken Seal§r to call him.
valdren.npc.bram.abandon: Dropped the job? Hm. At least you're honest. Some folks vanish with my tools.
valdren.npc.bram.affinity.comrade: You're the kind who can take the forge's heat. I like that.
valdren.npc.bram.affinity.confidant: If I had a kid, I'd want them as stubborn as you. You can count on me for anything.
valdren.npc.bram.affinity.friend: Friend, you're practically family to this anvil. I'll give you a good price.
valdren.npc.bram.affinity.known: Seen you around a few times. Haven't broken anything yet, that counts.
valdren.npc.bram.affinity.stranger: You? Don't know yet if you're good at work or just good at talking.
valdren.npc.bram.decline: Fine, fine. Work doesn't run away. Come back whenever.
valdren.npc.bram.greet.0: Hey! Right on time, the coals are just right. What brings you to my anvil?
valdren.npc.bram.greet.1: Mind the sparks, traveler. Burned off half my beard that way once. The other half is stubborn.
valdren.npc.bram.greet.2: Morning! Good iron is struck early, while the world is still cold. Need anything?
valdren.npc.bram.greet.friend: Ha! %s! Sit down, lean on the anvil. For you the forge is always lit.
valdren.npc.bram.greet.ready: I can see it on your face, the job is done. Go on, tell me!
valdren.npc.bram.more: Anything else? The coals wait for no one.
valdren.npc.bram.name: Bram Deephammer
valdren.npc.bram.noquest: Nothing for you today. Come back tomorrow, there's always iron to strike.
valdren.npc.bram.notyet: Not done yet. A hammer doesn't swing itself, traveler.
valdren.npc.bram.opt.quests: Got any work for me, master?
valdren.npc.bram.opt.story: Tell me about the royal forge.
valdren.npc.bram.opt.trade: Show me what's on the anvil.
valdren.npc.bram.questlocked: I've got a serious job, but I don't know you well enough yet. Work with me a bit more.
valdren.npc.bram.story.0: I was apprentice to Master Hadrik, smith of the Crown. He used to say: good steel takes a beating and doesn't complain. Like people.
valdren.npc.bram.story.1: The Shadow Wolves showed up after the Crown shattered. They say they're born from shadow leaking out of broken seals. I say they're just very angry wolves.
valdren.npc.bram.story.2: Master Hadrik forged the Sentinel Greatsword for the captain of the guard, Sir Calder. Two days and two nights of hammering. I held the tongs... and cried from exhaustion.
valdren.npc.bram.story.3: When the Eclipse swallowed Sir Calder, the sword went with him. If you ever bring that blade back, I'll recognize every hammer mark on it. Every single one.
valdren.npc.bram.story.locked: That story is too heavy for someone I just met. Another day, maybe.
valdren.npc.iara.abandon: That's alright, dear. We'll find another way. Don't be sad.
valdren.npc.iara.affinity.comrade: You help me so much I call you my godchild already.
valdren.npc.iara.affinity.confidant: Dear, you're family. Real family, the kind we choose.
valdren.npc.iara.affinity.friend: You're a sweetheart. If you ever get sick, just call me.
valdren.npc.iara.affinity.known: You're a familiar face now! Come in without knocking.
valdren.npc.iara.affinity.stranger: I don't really know you yet, but you have a kind face. That's half the way.
valdren.npc.iara.decline: No rush. Good plants take time to grow. Good people too.
valdren.npc.iara.greet.0: Oh, dear, come closer! I'm sorting some herbs. Fancy a little tea?
valdren.npc.iara.greet.1: Well, how nice to see you! The wind is gentle today and the plants are happy. Like me.
valdren.npc.iara.greet.2: Good afternoon, traveler! Sit a while, you look like you're not eating properly.
valdren.npc.iara.greet.friend: Oh, %s, I missed you! I saved a honey bun just for you. Don't tell the others, alright?
valdren.npc.iara.greet.ready: My, back already? Let me see if you brought everything!
valdren.npc.iara.name: Granny Iara
valdren.npc.iara.noquest: The garden is all in order today, thank goodness! Come by tomorrow, there's always something to do.
valdren.npc.iara.notyet: Still a little short, dear. Check your bag.
valdren.npc.iara.opt.affinity: How am I doing with you?
valdren.npc.iara.questlocked: There's something I'd like to ask, but it's dangerous. Let's get to know each other first.
valdren.npc.iara.story.0: I came from the Northern Waste, where the ice never melts. I came down with a sprout of every plant in my apron. Half died on the way. The other half is still with me.
valdren.npc.iara.story.1: Know why sweet berry tea helps a cough? Because my grandma said so. And hers too. Nobody ever argued with a grandma, so it works.
valdren.npc.iara.story.2: The Frost Wraiths were people, you know? People lost in a blizzard and trapped in the cold. That's why I keep a candle lit in the north window. So they can find their way.
valdren.npc.iara.story.3: In the Ancient Grove there's a tree that grew around a sword. I tended it for years. When you're ready, it will let the blade go with you.
valdren.npc.iara.story.locked: Oh, that's an old one, dear. I'll tell it when we're closer.
valdren.npc.orvyn.abandon: Not every story ends the way it began. I will record only the first chapter.
valdren.npc.orvyn.affinity.comrade: You have the curiosity of an apprentice and the courage of a guard. A rare mix.
valdren.npc.orvyn.affinity.confidant: Should I ever be gone, I want the Chronicles to be yours. I mean it.
valdren.npc.orvyn.affinity.friend: I consider you a friend. And I do not write that in ink lightly.
valdren.npc.orvyn.affinity.known: You appear often in my notes. A good sign.
valdren.npc.orvyn.affinity.stranger: I don't yet know what kind of story you will write. I am watching.
valdren.npc.orvyn.decline: I understand. Patience is also a chronicler's virtue.
valdren.npc.orvyn.greet.0: Ah, a traveler. The stars are coming out. A fine time for a conversation.
valdren.npc.orvyn.greet.1: Greetings. I was noting the movement of the winds. They have been restless lately.
valdren.npc.orvyn.greet.2: Welcome. Mind your step: this scroll is older than this village.
valdren.npc.orvyn.greet.friend: My dear %s! Your story grows interesting. You already have a chapter of your own in my chronicles.
valdren.npc.orvyn.greet.ready: I see you have done what I asked. Excellent. Tell me every detail, I write it all down.
valdren.npc.orvyn.more: Any other question? Questions are how every chronicle begins.
valdren.npc.orvyn.name: Master Orvyn
valdren.npc.orvyn.noquest: I have nothing to ask right now. Return when the stars have moved.
valdren.npc.orvyn.notyet: It is not complete yet. Half a chronicle serves no one.
valdren.npc.orvyn.opt.affinity: What do you think of me, master?
valdren.npc.orvyn.opt.trade: I'd like to see your wares.
valdren.npc.orvyn.questlocked: There is a grave task I must entrust to someone. But trust is built, traveler.
valdren.npc.orvyn.story.0: Valdren was a kingdom united by the Echo Crown, a crown that held the memory of every king. When it shattered, the memories scattered like shards: the Echo Fragments.
valdren.npc.orvyn.story.1: Echo Fragments attract greed. The Crimson Brotherhood raids villages for them, believing whoever gathers them all will be the new king. Fools. A crown is not a jigsaw puzzle.
valdren.npc.orvyn.story.2: Vorthrax was the guardian of the skies, bound by a pact with the ancient kings. When the Crown shattered, so did the pact. Now he is only storm and fury.
valdren.npc.orvyn.story.3: Sir Calder swore to protect the last piece of the Crown. He fought the Eclipse for seven nights. On the eighth, the Eclipse won, and he became the Lightless Knight. He still guards the fragment. He just doesn't remember why.
valdren.npc.orvyn.story.locked: That part of the chronicle is too dangerous for unfamiliar ears. Later, perhaps.
valdren.npc.ravena.abandon: Gave up? At least you came back alive. More than most.
valdren.npc.ravena.affinity.comrade: You fight well. I'll let you watch my back.
valdren.npc.ravena.affinity.confidant: If I ever fall on a hunt, I want you to have my bow. You're the only one I'd allow.
valdren.npc.ravena.affinity.friend: I trust you. Not something I say often. Don't ruin it.
valdren.npc.ravena.affinity.known: You're not dead yet. That already puts you above average.
valdren.npc.ravena.affinity.stranger: Trust? I barely know your name.
valdren.npc.ravena.decline: Whatever. The hunt goes on with or without you.
valdren.npc.ravena.greet.0: Keep it down. The night has ears. What do you want?
valdren.npc.ravena.greet.1: Oh, it's you. Thought you were another raider. You make the same noise.
valdren.npc.ravena.greet.2: Good moon for hunting. If you came for work, you're right on time.
valdren.npc.ravena.greet.friend: %s. Good to see you in one piece. Saved the best arrow in my quiver for tonight.
valdren.npc.ravena.greet.ready: Smells like battle. You did it, didn't you? Show me.
valdren.npc.ravena.more: Anything else? The prey won't wait.
valdren.npc.ravena.name: Ravena
valdren.npc.ravena.noquest: Nothing tonight. Even beasts need sleep. Sometimes.
valdren.npc.ravena.notyet: Not yet. Don't come back to me with half a hunt.
valdren.npc.ravena.opt.story: Tell me something from the road.
valdren.npc.ravena.questlocked: I have a big target. Too big for someone I haven't seen really fight.
valdren.npc.ravena.story.0: I hunt at night because that's when the bad things come out. Anyone is brave in daylight.
valdren.npc.ravena.story.1: The Crimson Brotherhood burned the village where I grew up. They wanted an Echo Fragment. There wasn't even one there. Since then, every raider I drop is one less debt.
valdren.npc.ravena.story.2: I once saw a Frost Wraith cry. Ice running down from its hood. Don't know if it was sorrow or just the cold. I shot anyway. Not proud of it.
valdren.npc.ravena.story.3: I've been tracking the Lightless Knight for three winters. He took someone I loved into the shadows. When I find his seal, I'll need someone at my side. Maybe you.
valdren.npc.ravena.story.locked: I don't tell that one to just anyone. Prove you're not just anyone first.
valdren.quest.bram_coal.accept: Mined or charcoal, doesn't matter. Fire isn't picky. I am.
valdren.quest.bram_coal.done: Now the forge roars! Thanks for the help.
valdren.quest.bram_coal.offer: The coals are dying. Can you get me twenty-four coal?
valdren.quest.bram_coal.progress: The fire is almost out, traveler...
valdren.quest.bram_coal.title: Coal for the fire
valdren.quest.bram_iron.accept: Good iron, mind you! No rust.
valdren.quest.bram_iron.done: Top-quality iron! Here are your emeralds.
valdren.quest.bram_iron.offer: I'm out of iron. Bring me sixteen ingots and I'll pay well.
valdren.quest.bram_iron.progress: And the iron? The anvil is hungry.
valdren.quest.bram_iron.ready: I hear iron clinking in your bag. Hand it over!
valdren.quest.bram_iron.title: Iron for the forge
valdren.quest.bram_raiders.accept: They roam the plains at night. Red hoods, can't miss them.
valdren.quest.bram_raiders.done: The Crimson Fang is yours now. Use it against them, it's what they deserve.
valdren.quest.bram_raiders.offer: Some Crimson Raiders stole my tools. Drop six of those rats and I'll give you a blade I took from them.
valdren.quest.bram_raiders.progress: There are still raiders out there laughing at me.
valdren.quest.bram_raiders.ready: Heard the Brotherhood is scared of someone. I think it's you!
valdren.quest.bram_raiders.title: The Crimson Brotherhood
valdren.quest.bram_wolves.accept: Thanks! Watch the bite, it blinds you. Bring a torch.
valdren.quest.bram_wolves.done: That's it! Now my cart rides in peace. Here, it's yours, well earned.
valdren.quest.bram_wolves.offer: Shadow Wolves attacked my coal cart yesterday. Take down five and I'll pay in emeralds.
valdren.quest.bram_wolves.progress: And the wolves? I still hear howling at night.
valdren.quest.bram_wolves.ready: From your face, the wolves learned their lesson. Come get your pay!
valdren.quest.bram_wolves.title: Wolves on the road
valdren.quest.iara_berries.done: The children thank you! Here's a little something.
valdren.quest.iara_berries.offer: Could you get me sixteen sweet berries? I make cough syrup for the children.
valdren.quest.iara_berries.title: Sweet berries
valdren.quest.iara_crystals.accept: Bring fire! The Wraiths fear fire. And bundle up.
valdren.quest.iara_crystals.done: With these I'll save many people. And this sword, the tree of the Ancient Grove let it go with you.
valdren.quest.iara_crystals.offer: I need four Frost Crystals for my strongest remedy. The Wraiths carry them in the frozen lands. It's dangerous, alright?
valdren.quest.iara_crystals.progress: Still no crystals? Come back in one piece first.
valdren.quest.iara_crystals.ready: My! You really went north? Show me those crystals!
valdren.quest.iara_crystals.title: Crystals of the north
valdren.quest.iara_mushrooms.accept: They grow in the dark corners of the woods. Don't eat any on the way!
valdren.quest.iara_mushrooms.done: With these I brew healing potions. Take two, you're always getting hurt.
valdren.quest.iara_mushrooms.offer: I need eight brown mushrooms for my healing broth. Help me?
valdren.quest.iara_mushrooms.title: Grove mushrooms
valdren.quest.iara_wheat.accept: What a blessing! Harvest away, the plants won't mind.
valdren.quest.iara_wheat.done: Such lovely wheat! Here, bread and honey, just like I promised.
valdren.quest.iara_wheat.offer: Dear, I want to bake bread for the whole village. Bring me twenty wheat? I'll pay with warm bread and honey.
valdren.quest.iara_wheat.progress: And the wheat, dear? The oven is warming up.
valdren.quest.iara_wheat.ready: I see wheat poking out of your bag! Bring it here!
valdren.quest.iara_wheat.title: Wheat for bread
valdren.quest.orvyn_books.accept: Plain books will do. The story is what makes them special.
valdren.quest.orvyn_books.done: Thank you. Take emeralds and some lapis for your own enchantments.
valdren.quest.orvyn_books.offer: My chronicles no longer fit in the books I have. Bring me six books?
valdren.quest.orvyn_books.progress: I am still waiting for the books.
valdren.quest.orvyn_books.ready: New books! The smell of paper is the finest perfume.
valdren.quest.orvyn_books.title: Paper for the chronicles
valdren.quest.orvyn_dragon.accept: When sparks draw circles on the ground, move away: lightning is coming. And when he dives from the sky, do not be under him.
valdren.quest.orvyn_dragon.done: The Ancestral Flame, blade of the first king. No one deserves it more. This chapter of the Chronicles is yours.
valdren.quest.orvyn_dragon.offer: It is time to face Vorthrax. Take this Storm Horn and blow it under open sky. End his fury and the sky will know peace again.
valdren.quest.orvyn_dragon.progress: The sky still thunders. Vorthrax lives.
valdren.quest.orvyn_dragon.ready: The sky is clear for the first time in years... you did it!
valdren.quest.orvyn_dragon.title: The fury of Vorthrax
valdren.quest.orvyn_echoes.accept: Dark creatures often carry them. Raiders too. Follow the trail of darkness.
valdren.quest.orvyn_echoes.done: Such beautiful, sad memories. The Dusk Blade is yours, as promised.
valdren.quest.orvyn_echoes.offer: Echo Fragments hold memories of the old kingdom. Bring me six and I will give you a blade forged in the last light before the Eclipse.
valdren.quest.orvyn_echoes.progress: Echoes are still missing. Each tells a piece of the story.
valdren.quest.orvyn_echoes.ready: I can hear the echoes from here... you found them!
valdren.quest.orvyn_echoes.title: Echoes of the crown
valdren.quest.orvyn_essence.accept: Shadow Wolves leave it behind when they fall. Do not keep it near your heart.
valdren.quest.orvyn_essence.done: Fascinating. Take your payment, and some bottled wisdom.
valdren.quest.orvyn_essence.offer: I must study Shadow Essence. Bring me ten and I will pay well for the risk.
valdren.quest.orvyn_essence.progress: Essences are still missing for the study.
valdren.quest.orvyn_essence.ready: I feel the essence's chill from here. Bring it.
valdren.quest.orvyn_essence.title: Study of shadows
valdren.quest.ravena_hunt.accept: They attack in groups. Fight with your back to a tree.
valdren.quest.ravena_hunt.done: Here. And meat, because a hungry hunter misses.
valdren.quest.ravena_hunt.offer: A pack of Shadow Wolves is hunting in the forests. Drop eight.
valdren.quest.ravena_hunt.progress: The pack is still out there.
valdren.quest.ravena_hunt.title: Shadow pack
valdren.quest.ravena_knight.accept: When he strikes the ground, back off. When he dashes, get out of the way. Good luck. To both of us.
valdren.quest.ravena_knight.done: Three winters. It's over. Take the Moonlight Katana. It belonged to the one I lost. He'd want it to be yours.
valdren.quest.ravena_knight.offer: I found his seal. Break this Broken Seal and the Lightless Knight appears. I can't do it alone. Are you coming?
valdren.quest.ravena_knight.progress: Is the seal still whole? Or are you still working up the nerve?
valdren.quest.ravena_knight.ready: He fell? He really fell? Talk to me...
valdren.quest.ravena_knight.title: The Lightless Knight
valdren.quest.ravena_wraiths.accept: They throw ice. Don't stand still and stay away from water.
valdren.quest.ravena_wraiths.done: The Frost Blade is yours. Found it on a hunter who wasn't as lucky as you.
valdren.quest.ravena_wraiths.offer: Four Frost Wraiths are coming down from the north. Drop them before they reach the villages. The reward is worth the cold.
valdren.quest.ravena_wraiths.progress: The Wraiths are still coming. I can feel the cold from here.
valdren.quest.ravena_wraiths.ready: Your coat is full of ice. You did it.
valdren.quest.ravena_wraiths.title: Hunt in the ice
valdren.quest.ravena_zombies.accept: Aim for the head. Or don't. They don't care much.
valdren.quest.ravena_zombies.done: Here. Arrows for the next hunt.
valdren.quest.ravena_zombies.offer: Zombies are prowling the village. Drop ten. I'll pay in arrows and emeralds.
valdren.quest.ravena_zombies.progress: Still too many zombies out there.
valdren.quest.ravena_zombies.ready: The village is quieter. Good work.
valdren.quest.ravena_zombies.title: Night cleanup
valdren.summon.need_sky: You need to be under open sky to use this.
valdren.welcome: You received the Chronicles of Valdren. Right-click the book to begin your journey!
